name: haramara
description: Haramara Café — WordPress commerce engine (block theme + haramara-core plugin); Expo customer + POS apps arrive in the app phase. Root workspace: tooling, local dev, and asset builds.
author: Haramara Café — Agency Build

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.env:install-content: wp-env run cli wp haramara install
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('\n[haramara] Node deps installed. Next: composer install (PHP tooling), then npm run env:start to boot the local WordPress, then npm run build to compile theme SCSS/JS.')"
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/api-client && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/pos && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/customer
